markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (89%)** · Confident · Careful review
Single-class conformal set, but the second model disagrees and only 1 of 5 similar cases match.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | InSitu 89%, Invasive 8% | Clear leader |
| Conformal set | {InSitu} at 90% | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.99 / 1.0 | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Different top class |
| Similar cases | 1 of 5 InSitu [F5] | Weak support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Scores below typical; pulls concept model away from invasive [F3] · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined in ducts** (regions 0, 8) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; fits in situ over invasive [F4] · Weak
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (region 11) · ↓ invasive · Scores below typical; also points away from invasive · Validated

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0: not shown to reflect classifier use. Necrosis (3/20) and normal lobules (0/20) are Unreliable.

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated blur (severity 3) degrades nuclear detail; the second model picked a different class.
- Region 6 shows 76% per-region invasive risk, far above the image-level 8%.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 0, 8:** Confirm atypical cells stay inside ducts, with no stromal breach.
2. **Region 10:** Look for stromal invasion; mitosis score is unreliable (0/20), so count by eye.
3. **Regions 8, 11:** Verify tumor-at-margin call at inferior, medial, lateral edges [F7].
